replicate::1#1.why: started first, completed second; append order would score the SR=0 replicate

timed_out::2#2.why: the timed_out attempt started first and scores SR=1; status != ok, so it is not complete

only_timeout::3#3.why: no complete attempt; a timed_out row is scored and stays in the denominator through the scored fallback

retry::4#4.why: the infra attempt started first; it is dropped at read, so the re-queued attempt is the result
